extensionDescription.message: Read Spanish on the web: unknown words highlighted, an honest percentage. Offline and private.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description: the extensions page, and both stores' summary. At most 112 characters (Apple's limit). Names the languages an English reader can study in the shipped pairs (Spanish, es-en) — not a translation of the French. US English.

commandCaptureSelection.message: Capture the selection (a word or a phrase) with its sentence
commandCaptureSelection.description: The Alt+L command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: capture the selected word or phrase together with its sentence.

commandToggleDrawer.message: Open or close the review panel on the page
commandToggleDrawer.description: The Alt+Shift+D command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: open or close the in-page review panel (the drawer).

commandSidePanel.description: The Alt+Shift+S command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: open the browser's review side panel (Chromium).
